{{Quote|I'm a businessman, General. My loyalty is to my investors.|Myn Weaver to [[Hera Syndulla]]|<ref name="Part Two" />}}
'''Myn Weaver''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who operated on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] as a [[Regional Supervisor]] for the [[New Republic]]. He was secretly an [[Imperial Remnants|Imperial]] loyalist who worked for the industrialist and [[witch]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] and her [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|forces]].<ref name="Part Two" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Myn Weaver, portrayed by [[Peter Jacobson]], appeared in "[[Part Two: Toil and Trouble]]," the second episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''.<ref name="Part Two" />

Weaver is possibly named in reference to American pop singer-songwriter, [[wikipedia:Ryn Weaver|Ryn Weaver]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|RynWeaver|status/1694544754766397511|✦ Ryn Weaver ✦|date=2023-08-23|quote=ive been informed there is a character on the new star wars show named MYN WEAVER who is also a businessman…|archiveurl=https://archive.is/sNTCE}}</ref>
